sources.title: Automated migration tool for Pydantic v1 to v2 · pydantic/pydantic · Discussion #12772 · GitHub

entries.title: BaseModel method renames
entries.migration: Replace all V1 BaseModel method calls with V2 equivalents: __fields__ -> model_fields, construct() -> model_construct(), copy() -> model_copy(), dict() -> model_dump(), json() -> model_dump_json(), parse_obj() -> model_validate(), json_schema() -> model_json_schema(). ValidationError moves from pydantic.error_wrappers to pydantic.ValidationError.
entries.quote: Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__. Where possible, we have retained the deprecated methods with their old names to help ease migration, but calling them will emit DeprecationWarning`s.

entries.title: Field property removals and renames
entries.migration: Remove or rename Field properties: const, min_items -> min_length, max_items -> max_length, unique_items, allow_mutation -> frozen, regex -> pattern, final. Use json_schema_extra dict instead of arbitrary kwargs for schema extras. alias returns None when no alias is set (changed from field name).
entries.quote: Field no longer supports arbitrary keyword arguments to be added to the JSON schema. Instead, any extra data you want to add to the JSON schema should be passed as a dictionary to the json_schema_extra keyword argument.

entries.title: validator and root_validator deprecation
entries.migration: Replace @validator with @field_validator and @root_validator with @model_validator. Deprecated validators cannot use field or config keyword arguments. always=True now applies standard type validators to defaults. TypeError raised in validators is no longer converted to ValidationError.
entries.quote: @validator has been deprecated, and should be replaced with @field_validator, which provides various new features and improvements.

entries.title: BaseSettings relocation
entries.migration: BaseSettings moved to separate pydantic-settings package. Import as from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings. parse_env_var classmethod removed; use custom settings sources instead.
entries.quote: BaseSettings has moved to a separate package, pydantic-settings.

entries.title: Config class replacement
entries.migration: Replace inner class Config with model_config = ConfigDict(...) class attribute. Renamed config settings: allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name, anystr_lower -> str_to_lower, anystr_strip_whitespace -> str_strip_whitespace, anystr_upper -> str_to_upper, keep_untouched -> ignored_types, max_anystr_length -> str_max_length, min_anystr_length -> str_min_length, orm_mode -> from_attributes, schema_extra -> json_schema_extra, validate_all -> validate_default.
entries.quote: In Pydantic V2, to specify config on a model, you should set a class attribute called model_config to be a dict with the key/value pairs you want to be used as the config.

entries.title: Behavioral changes and deprecations
entries.migration: Deprecated methods still work but emit DeprecationWarning (treated as test failures). Models now only equal other BaseModel instances (not dicts). JSON serialization uses str(key) for non-string keys. Float to int conversion now requires zero decimal part. Union validation short-circuits on first match. Config settings underscore_attrs_are_private now always True behavior.
entries.quote: Models can only be equal to other BaseModel instances. For two model instances to be equal, they must have the same Type, Field values, Extra values, Private attribute values.

payload.summary: Migration from pydantic 1.10.13 to 2.14.1 involves breaking changes to BaseModel methods, Field properties, validators, config, and BaseSettings relocation. The codebase imports pydantic.Field, BaseModel, validator, root_validator, BaseSettings, and ValidationError. Most listed symbols have direct V2 equivalents but with renamed APIs or moved locations. The migration requires updating method calls, decorator usage, config class names, and import paths.

payload.analysis: The upgrade to pydantic 2.14.1 breaks imports and APIs in two modules. In `pyshop/models.py`: ValidationError moved from `pydantic.error_wrappers` to `pydantic`; `BaseModel` methods renamed (`__fields__` -> `model_fields`, `dict()` -> `model_dump()`, `parse_obj()` -> `model_validate()`); `@validator` -> `@field_validator`, `@root_validator` -> `@model_validator`; inner `Config` class replaced with `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` with renamed settings (`orm_mode` -> `from_attributes`, `anystr_strip_whitespace` -> `str_strip_whitespace`); `Field(const=True)` removed (use `frozen=True` or handle via validator); `Field(default_factory=...)` syntax changed. In `pyshop/settings.py`: `BaseSettings` moved to `pydantic_settings` package. Both files must be fully rewritten to use the new APIs so imports succeed and tests run.

edits.justification: Migrated all pydantic 1.x APIs to 2.x equivalents: imports, ValidationError location, BaseModel method names, validator decorators, Config class to model_config with renamed settings, Field(const=True) replaced with after-validator, default_factory syntax updated, and root_validator became model_validator.
Migrated BaseSettings import to pydantic_settings package, replaced inner Config class with model_config = SettingsConfigDict(...), and kept Field usage compatible with v2.
